sections.name: body
sections.value:
Start here after a compact or when taking over pa. Read these in order (pij directory memory pa --note <slug>):
1. wind-down-at-rest-2026-11-10: fleet state at rest and the round procedure.
2. prime-is-silkworm: escalations go to pij-outstanding-silkworm.
3. compaction-line-600k, recheck-size-before-compact, digest-ctx-stale-after-compaction: read the pane footer and events.jsonl, never the digest figure.
4. held-compact-can-drop-f180, f180-compact-only-without-subagents, f180-root-cause-reload-before-compact: verify every compact in events.jsonl; compact before reload rollouts and only with no sub-agent running; escalate after one drop.
5. f111-wake-automatic, reviewer-queued-next-turn-stall: who to flag when idle.
6. receiver-lease-not-delivery-flag, pij-rs-symlink-into-target: what to check when sends or pij-rs fail.
Withdrawn: the ctrl+d dialog exceptions (dropped for good 08 Nov) and the 400k line (now 600k).
State at this compact (11 Nov 10:00): fleet resting until Jordan names work; nothing in flight for pa; pij-rs restored 09:58.
